articles.title: Anthropic falls nearly 9% in first full day of trading as tech stocks get shellacked
articles.summary: Anthropic shares fell 8.5% on Friday to close their first full day of trading, as concerns about the artificial intelligence trade continued to drag tech stocks lower. The stock opened at $111.50 on the Nasdaq Thursday after Anthropic raised $81.3 billion in the largest IPO of all time, but shares slid throughout the day and closed at $97.17.

articles.title: Jensen Huang to testify publicly before Senate banking panel, Chairman Scott says
articles.summary: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang will testify publicly when he appears before the Senate banking panel, a spokesperson for Committee Chair Tim Scott said Friday.
